tenants.superInactive: Super-admin mode inactive from your IP
tenants.superRestricted: Tenant management is restricted to super admins connecting from an allowed IP. The server sees your IP as {{ip}}.
tenants.superAllowlistNote: The allowlist is set via <mono>SUPER_ADMIN_ALLOWED_IPS</mono> in the server environment and can't be changed from here. Add your IP there (then re-log in) to manage tenants.
tenants.superOnlyDesc: Managing tenants requires a super-admin account. To change your own tenant's branding or plugins, use Settings.
tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.platformTitle: Platform tenant — owns the super-admin account
tenants.platformNoDelete: The platform tenant can't be deleted
tenants.deleteDesc: This removes {{name}} from the tenant list. Its data schema is left intact on the database and must be dropped separately.
tenants.slugHintEdit: The slug can't be changed after creation.
tenants.slugHintNew: Used for login and identification. Auto-generated from the name.
tenants.domainHint: The host that resolves to this tenant. Use <mono>localhost</mono> for the local dev tenant.
tenants.activeHint: Disabled tenants return 403 on every request.
tenants.provisionHint: Creating a tenant provisions its schema, base tables and a seed admin (<mono>admin@{{host}}</mono>, password <mono>admin</mono>) automatically.
